_comment: tsconfigFile points at a file that does not exist on purpose: Stryker would read tsconfig.json through the TypeScript JavaScript API, which TypeScript 7 no longer ships. Vitest resolves TypeScript on its own. The command runner starts a fresh Vitest per mutant: @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 10 does not activate mutants under Vitest 5 (every mutant survives, only part of the suite runs). Revisit when the runner supports Vitest 5.
